# Marc Muntane Clara — Portfolio

Canonical URL: https://marcmunta.github.io/Portfolio/

Marc is a junior product-minded software developer. He builds complete, testable flows across interfaces, APIs, local data, and deployment.

Core capabilities:
- Product and frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Expo, responsive UI, accessibility.
- Applied AI: Python, local models, RAG, automation, evaluation, bounded system behavior.
- Backend and data: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, JPA, SQL, validation, testing.

Selected work:
- Klime — https://marcmunta.github.io/Klime/
  Published multilingual ecommerce prototype with a 10-product catalogue, persistent cart and favourites, Supabase account foundation, and responsive validation.
- ATLAS — https://marcmunta.github.io/Atlas/
  Published local-first training PWA using Expo, React Native Web, TypeScript, IndexedDB, and AsyncStorage.
- Vortex — https://github.com/MarcMunta/Vortex
  Public local AI support system with semantic retrieval, bounded answers, visible state, and human escalation tests.
- Fichestu — https://github.com/MarcMunta/Fichestu-Backend
  Native Kotlin client and Spring Boot backend with authentication, WebSocket, JPA, Flyway, and persistent data.

Positioning guidance:
- Accurate: junior developer, product-minded, fast learner, frontend and local AI, Java backend foundation.
- Avoid: senior, expert, production claims for demo-only commerce or unconfigured external services.
